name: Make
verdict: A visual automation tool with a free 1,000-credit plan. The paid dollar prices were not in the pricing page text we could read.
pros: Free plan is stated on the pricing page
cons: Paid dollar amounts were not in the page text
Credits expire at the end of the term
pricingNote: On 2026-10-14 the pricing page FAQ said the Free plan includes 1,000 credits a month. Core, Pro, and Teams are named, and annual billing is cheaper, but their dollar prices were not in the text we could read. A direct HTML download of the same URL was a Cloudflare challenge. See the vendor site before paying.
